body:
There are crystals that do one thing beautifully. And then there is Super 7.

Held at your heart center, the Seven & Stone Necklace carries one of the most complete energetic combinations in the crystal world. Super 7 — also known as Melody's Stone — is a rare formation containing seven distinct minerals: amethyst, clear quartz, smoky quartz, cacoxenite, rutile, goethite, and lepidocrocite. Each brings its own frequency. Together, they create something greater than the sum of their parts — a stone that grounds, protects, amplifies, and expands all at once.

Strung alongside the Super 7 pendant are beads of Pilbara Jasper, sourced from one of the most ancient landscapes on Earth. Formed nearly 2.5 billion years ago in the Pilbara region of Western Australia, this jasper carries a deep, stabilizing earth energy that anchors the cosmic frequency of Super 7 and keeps you rooted as you rise.

Worn at the chest, this necklace works where it matters most — close to the heart, in direct contact with your energy field. It's a piece you'll feel as much as you'll wear. Bold enough to be a conversation starter. Intentional enough to be a daily practice.

Whether you're navigating a season of change, seeking clarity, or simply ready to call in more — the Seven & Stone Necklace meets you there.

This is total energetic support. Worn.
